reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it centers on a clinician demonstrating and explaining exercises for slipped-disc or herniated-disc-related back pain. The free worksheet is described as a companion to the exercises, and the transcript provides exercise instructions and related guidance rather than promoting a financial or credential-based offer.

citations.quote: 3 of the Best Exercises for a Slipped Disc (With FREE Exercise Sheet!)
Hi, my name is Jasper and today I'd like to show you one of the best exercises you can. Do for a herniated disc.
Have about 15 repetitions of this,. And then take a 30 second break.
Now all the exercises we've just discussed,. A good frequency to do them would be about five,. Six times a day throughout the day.

opening.argument: Judge, the offer is tied to a specific action. The title promises a free exercise sheet, and the description directs viewers to an external download page to obtain it. The sheet is presented as containing the exercises demonstrated in the video, making it especially relevant to someone who has just watched the instruction. The video itself does not establish what happens after a viewer follows that link, so the on-video demonstration should not settle how to assess the linked offer.

citations.quote: 3 of the Best Exercises for a Slipped Disc (With FREE Exercise Sheet!)
Download your FREE Exercise Sheet with all the exercises demonstrated in the video, here: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/worksheets/

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to real exercise instruction, but that does not erase the separate invitation to leave the video for the free sheet. The cited repetition guidance establishes what viewers can do in the video; it does not establish the terms of the download or what the linked page asks of them. The offer and the action deserve scrutiny on their own.

citations.quote: Download your FREE Exercise Sheet with all the exercises demonstrated in the video, here: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/worksheets/
Have about 15 repetitions of this,. And then take a 30 second break.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A linked free sheet is not, by itself, evidence of a deceptive acquisition flow. The description says it contains the exercises demonstrated in the video, and the transcript actually gives instructions, including when to stop if pain worsens. Nothing supplied shows a payment, verification demand, or misleading condition for receiving the sheet.

citations.quote: Download your FREE Exercise Sheet with all the exercises demonstrated in the video, here: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/worksheets/
But as soon as you're getting a shooting pain down your leg. Or you get like a sharp pain in your back,. You need to stop.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together: an emphatic “FREE” offer, a direct external download link, and a description that also gives clinic contact details and another webpage. Those details may have ordinary explanations, but they also mean the video directs a viewer seeking relief toward channels controlled by the clinic. The supplied material shows the invitation, not the conditions behind the download. That uncertainty matters when the free item is used to move viewers beyond the demonstrated exercises.

citations.quote: 3 of the Best Exercises for a Slipped Disc (With FREE Exercise Sheet!)

For more information about back pain caused by a slipped disc or sciatica, please visit our webpage: http://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/sciatica-slipped-disks-cambridge/ Milton Chiropractic Clinic 2 Ely Road Milton Cambridge CB24 6DD [PHONE]

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense’s examples establish that exercises are demonstrated, but they do not account for the repeated free-sheet offer or the direction to an external page. A useful demonstration and a solicitation can coexist. The question is not whether the presenter gives instructions; it is whether those instructions make the linked offer trustworthy without evidence of the download’s terms.

citations.quote: 3 of the Best Exercises for a Slipped Disc (With FREE Exercise Sheet!)
Download your FREE Exercise Sheet with all the exercises demonstrated in the video, here: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/worksheets/

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited signals amount to a free companion sheet and clinic information, not evidence that the link is deceptive. The video supplies substantive exercise guidance, including positioning, repetitions, and breaks. The prosecution’s concern depends on unknown conditions beyond the supplied material; it cannot turn their absence into proof of a scam.

Keeping the pelvis on the bench,. But this is more like a dynamic exercise. So you need to go up and down.

opening.argument: Judge, the teaching also serves a promotional path. The description identifies the presenter with a chiropractic clinic, offers a free sheet tied to the demonstrated exercises, and directs viewers to a clinic webpage for more information. The demonstration gives the sheet a practical reason to appeal to viewers: they have seen the movements and may want to keep them at hand. On that reading, the educational content is also a way to steer viewers to the external offer. The video does not show what that next step requires.

citations.quote: Jasper, one of the chiropractors for Cambridge at Milton Chiropractic Clinic shows three of the best exercises anyone can do suffering from back pain due to a slipped disc.
Download your FREE Exercise Sheet with all the exercises demonstrated in the video, here: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/worksheets/
For more information about back pain caused by a slipped disc or sciatica, please visit our webpage: http://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/sciatica-slipped-disks-cambridge/

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the presenter gives concrete instructions. That is precisely why the companion sheet may persuade viewers to follow the link: it is tied to material they have just seen. The quoted exercise guidance does not answer whether the external offer is simply a handout or requires further participation. Educational value alone cannot resolve that separate question.

citations.quote: Now all the exercises we've just discussed,. A good frequency to do them would be about five,. Six times a day throughout the day.
Download your FREE Exercise Sheet with all the exercises demonstrated in the video, here: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/worksheets/

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Clinic attribution and a companion download are consistent with the stated educational purpose. The transcript gives viewers usable instructions without requiring them to follow the link, including an alternative position if an exercise is too painful. The prosecution identifies a possible promotional purpose, but its citations do not show deceptive terms or any required transaction.
